name: Saving Sharpbeak
summary: Gryphon Master Talonaxe sends you to the summit of Jintha'Alor, which stands in the heart of Vilebranch territory. Vile Priestess Hexx has the key to Sharpbeak's cage, and you are to take it from her and free the gryphon.

sections.title: Up Jintha'Alor
sections.body: Following Thadius Grimshade's divination and your report to Talonaxe, the way to rescue Sharpbeak is clear. Jintha'Alor stands in the heart of Vilebranch territory, and you are to fight your way to its summit. Vile Priestess Hexx holds the key to Sharpbeak's cage. Take it from her, then find the cage and save the gryphon.

sections.title: Talonaxe's Thanks
sections.body: Swiftwind and Keenclaw have already brought their child home and cannot stop fussing over him. The sight leaves Talonaxe misty-eyed. Talonaxe says the debt cannot be repaid, and that Aerie Peak's gryphons and riders will long sing your name.

faq.q: Who sends you to rescue Sharpbeak?
aliases: where do i start saving sharpbeak
faq.answer: Gryphon Master Talonaxe asks you to rescue Sharpbeak, after the divination revealed where the gryphon is held.
Sharpbeak is caged at the summit of Jintha'Alor, a place within Vilebranch territory in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who holds the key to Sharpbeak's cage?
faq.answer: Vile Priestess Hexx has the key needed to open Sharpbeak's cage.
